# Catalog

Plugins of the `acme` marketplace. Generated by `./mb gen` from each plugin's
`plugin.src.json`, `SKILL.md` files and `config.defaults.json`. Do not edit.

## alpha

Alpha plugin. Has two configurable skills.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Version | `1.2.3+mb.9f6c7bf1` |
| Source | `./plugins/alpha` |
| Category | Coding |
| Keywords | `alpha`, `demo` |
| Configurable | yes |
| Host-specific components | - |
| Org policy | required |
| Install (Claude Code) | `claude plugin install alpha@acme` |
| Install (Codex) | not available (Claude Code only) |

### Skills

| Skill | Description |
|---|---|
| `alpha-one` | First alpha skill. Use when testing. |
| `alpha-two` | Second alpha skill, folded over two lines. Use when testing. |

### Default settings

```json
{
  "maxItems": 5,
  "sections": [
    "Summary",
    "Next steps"
  ],
  "strict": false
}
```
